build_tokenizer: build a tokenizer using build_tokenizer with name bytes sp tiktoken or mock and an optional model path
encode_text_bytes: encode text to byte tokens using ByteTokenizer encode with optional bos and eos flags
encode_text_sentencepiece: encode text to tokens using SentencePieceTokenizer encode with a SentencePiece model file path
encode_text_tiktoken: encode text to tokens using TikTokenTokenizer encode with a tiktoken model file path
get_token_offsets: get token substrings and byte offsets from text using any tokenizer get_token_offsets method
